title: aberrantia aberrans
intro: Aberrantia aberrans, commonly known as the Desert Lavender or Dwarf Lavender, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is a shrub-like plant native to the southwestern regions of North America, characterized by its small purple flowers and fragrance. The health benefits of Aberrantia aberrans include its potential to alleviate stress, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
